name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2024-05-16.202.1) that the remaining stages of the bills be agreed to and the bills be now passed. This means the bills will now return to the House of Representatives, where our MPs will consider the Senate's amendments. ### What do the bills do? The [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2324a/24bd054) set out the following key points: * *The purpose of the [Administrative Review Tribunal Bill 2023](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/Bills_Search_Results/Result?bId=r7117) is to establish the [Administrative Review Tribunal](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Administrative_Review_Tribunal) (the Tribunal), which will replace the Administrative Appeals Tribunal. The Bill details the Tribunal’s membership, structure, review procedures and other matters.
